annotations.text:
Color system, taken from the reference screens
Dark charcoal chrome (#202126 / #2a2b30) with white bold titles. Content on light gray (#e6e7ea) with white cards, near-black text (#2b2c30), gray secondary (#6f7076).
Cyan = Go / selected tab (#1fb9d2). Lime = Claim (#9be22a). Gray = In Progress / locked (#b7b8bd). Gold progress fill on a dark track with the count in a pill. Improved values read before » after with the after in cyan. Red dot only where a claim is waiting.

A · Nightfall
Closest to the game: a night-sky stage with your avatar, hex level badge, orange accents, green EXP bar, a card-stacked mission panel.
Tradeoff: the busiest of the three; the stage takes a quarter of the screen.

B · Questbook
A paper quest log. Warm cream, serif headings, missions in one ledger card, the week shown as small pips. Calm and readable.
Tradeoff: least 'game'; the level-up and Day Clear moments will need motion to feel like rewards.

C · Arcade Ledger (chosen)
Numbers first: Life Power as a big mono figure with a sparkline, a four-stat strip, dense rows. High contrast lime on near-black.
Tradeoff: coldest tone; the avatar is reduced to a badge, so the character metaphor is weakest.
